# VERIDIAN AI OS — Configuration Reference

Closes the [Medium] "AI-Readable Configuration Documentation" finding (VERIDIAN Review Framework,
AI Documentation gap-closure, 2026-08-07, `UMR-20260801-170930-2080` sub-task). No consolidated
config reference existed before this file (no `CONFIGURATION.md`, no `.env.example`) -- every
`process.env.*` reference lived only in its own call site.

**Generated by direct grep of `src/` + `scripts/` on 2026-08-07 -- 54 distinct `process.env.*`
vars found.** `scripts/check-configuration-doc-coverage.mjs` (CI-wired) keeps this table honest
going forward: it fails the build if a new `process.env.X` appears in `src/` without a matching
row below. Re-run that script's own grep to regenerate this list if it drifts; this file is not
auto-generated the way `docs/master/MODULE_DOC_INDEX.md` is, because grouping/purpose needs a
human read of each call site, not just extraction.

---

## Core required (already listed in `CLAUDE.md`, repeated here for one-stop reference)

| Var | Purpose | Set where |
|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Primary Postgres connection string (Supabase pooler preferred) — `src/lib/db/index.ts` builds the Drizzle client from this. | Vercel env / local `.env` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | Supabase project URL — Supabase Auth SSR client (`src/lib/supabase/client.ts`/`server.ts`) and every script that talks to Supabase directly. | Vercel env / local `.env` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Supabase anon key — public, RLS-scoped client auth. | Vercel env / local `.env` |
| `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | Supabase service-role key — server-side only, bypasses RLS; used by seed/admin scripts (`scripts/wave111-create-hero-logins.ts`) and any server route that needs cross-tenant access. **Never expose client-side.** | Vercel env (server) / local `.env` |
| `APP_RUNTIME_DATABASE_URL` | Second connection string for the `app_runtime` role (least-privilege runtime DB user, distinct from the migration/admin role `DATABASE_URL` may carry) — defaulted to a placeholder in tests (`route.test.ts`) so importing `policy-enforcement-engine.ts` doesn't throw at module load without a real DB. | Vercel env / local `.env` |

## AI / LLM provider keys

| Var | Purpose | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Primary LLM gateway key — the AI Dev Team roster (`ai-team/team-service.ts`) and `scripts/ai-workforce-agent.mjs` route almost every model call through OpenRouter. | `scripts/ai-workforce-agent.mjs` |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | Direct Anthropic key — test-only reference today (`mother-router.test.ts`); the "Claude Code (Secondary Agent)" `claude-task` dispatch path documented in `AGENTS.md` has never had a working job wired to a real key (see `Study_by_Claude.md`). | `src/lib/ai-router/mother-router.test.ts` |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | OpenAI key for `orchestra-model-resolver.ts`'s provider routing. | `src/lib/orchestra-model-resolver.test.ts` |
| `GOOGLE_API_KEY` | Google (Gemini) key, same resolver. | `src/lib/orchestra-model-resolver.ts` |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` | Groq key — floor-tier (`gpt-oss-120b`) fast/cheap capacity; optional live-path smoke test only runs if this is present. | `scripts/defense-in-depth-smoke-test.ts` |
| `CEREBRAS_API_KEY` | Cerebras key — paid fallback for `gpt-oss-120b` generation load when Groq's free-tier 200K TPD cap is hit (real finding from a load test, see the source comment). | `scripts/projexa-load-test.ts` |
| `COMPOSIO_API_KEY` | Composio connector integration key (test-only reference today). | `src/lib/composio-connectors.test.ts` |
| `AI_CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY` | Encrypts/decrypts org-level AI provider config (BYO API keys) at rest. | `src/lib/ai-config-crypto.ts` |

## AI Dev Team dispatch (`scripts/ai-workforce-agent.mjs` — the headless worker entrypoint)

| Var | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `AI_TEAM_ROLE_KEY` | Which roster role (`src/lib/ai-team/roster.ts`) this invocation is dispatching as. |
| `AI_TEAM_TASK_OBJECTIVE`, `AI_TEAM_TASK_SCOPE`, `AI_TEAM_TASK_SUCCESS_CRITERIA`, `AI_TEAM_TASK_EXPECTED_OUTPUT`, `AI_TEAM_TASK_COMPLEXITY_TIER` | The `TightTask` envelope fields (see `src/lib/task-tightening.ts` — `validateTightTask` rejects if any of these is missing/placeholder/too short). |
| `AI_TEAM_TASK_CONSTRAINTS`, `AI_TEAM_TASK_KNOWN_CONTEXT` | Optional `TightTask` fields. |
| `AI_TEAM_SUPABASE_URL`, `AI_TEAM_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Supabase creds scoped to this dispatch (falls back to a hardcoded project URL if unset — see the script). |
| `AI_TEAM_LOG_URL`, `AI_TEAM_LOG_SECRET` | Where/how this run's activity is logged back to the platform. |
| `GITHUB_OUTPUT` | Standard GitHub Actions output-file mechanism — the script writes step outputs here when running as a workflow step. |

## GitHub / CI context (consumed by `scripts/check-*.mjs` and `scripts/validate-audit-verdict.ts`)

| Var | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GH_TOKEN` | `gh` CLI / GitHub API auth for scripts that need it (e.g. posting audit verdicts). Known limitation: the token available in interactive sessions lacks the `workflow` OAuth scope, so it cannot push a branch containing a `.github/workflows/*.yml` change — see `ai-os/registry/PENDING-CI-WIRING-architecture-doc-drift.patch` for the current live example. |
| `GITHUB_ACTOR` | Who triggered the run — recorded on audit verdicts. |
| `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` | Path to the GitHub Actions event payload JSON — `check-reviewer-not-author.mjs` reads the PR author/reviewer from it. |
| `GITHUB_BASE_REF`, `GITHUB_HEAD_REF`, `BASE_REF` | Branch refs for diff-scoped checks (`check-sec07-ocid-lock.mjs`, `validate-audit-verdict.ts`, `check-migration-collision.mjs`). `BASE_REF` is the explicit override so a script's git diff doesn't fall back to a possibly-stale local `main` in a shared checkout/worktree (real bug fixed 2026-07-30, see `check-migration-collision.mjs`'s header). |
| `REPO`, `PR_NUMBER` | Which repo/PR `validate-audit-verdict.ts` is validating. |

## Email

| Var | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `RESEND_API_KEY` | Resend transactional-email provider key — email sending no-ops (returns `null`) if unset, rather than throwing. |
| `EMAIL_FROM` | From-address override; defaults to `VERIDIAN AI <noreply@veridian-compliance.ai>`. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` | Base app URL used to build links inside emails; defaults to the production Vercel URL. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` | Same purpose, used by `contact-service.ts`'s confirmation-link builder specifically (separate constant from `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` above — both exist, not yet consolidated). |

## Observability

| Var | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `SENTRY_DSN`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN` | Server/client Sentry DSNs respectively (`sentry.server.config.ts`/`sentry.edge.config.ts` and `instrumentation-client.ts`). |
| `NODE_ENV` | Standard Node env; also used directly to pick Sentry's trace sample rate (1.0 in development, 0.1 otherwise). |
| `NEXT_RUNTIME` | Next.js's own runtime marker (`"nodejs"` vs `"edge"`) — `instrumentation.ts` branches server-only setup on it. |
| `MEMVID_TELEMETRY` | Force-set to `"0"` before `@memvid/sdk` is ever required, to disable its default phone-home telemetry (path-hash + command-name event per operation) — closes a real finding from the workspace-memory design doc's §2.5. |

## Webhooks / internal-endpoint secrets

| Var | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `CRON_SECRET` | Shared secret guarding `/api/internal/ai-performance-report/run` from unauthenticated triggers. |
| `OPS_SYNC_SECRET` | Same pattern, guards `/api/internal/ops-task-sync`. |
| `VERCEL_DEPLOYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Verifies inbound Vercel deployment webhooks. |
| `PLATFORM_AUDIT_ORG_ID` | Which org the Vercel-deployment webhook attributes platform-level audit events to. |
| `VERCEL_URL` | Vercel's own runtime-injected deployment URL — used to build an absolute `/api/v1` base URL when constructing external links from server code. |
| `ORCHESTRA_PAYLOAD_RETENTION_DAYS` | Retention window (days) for the orchestra log purge job; falls back to a coded default if unset/non-numeric. |
| `GITHUB_DISPATCH_PAT` | PAT used by `ai-team/dispatch-repo.ts` to fire `repository_dispatch` events (the `zai-task`/`claude-task` triggers documented in `AGENTS.md`). |

| Var | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD` | Used by `src/lib/db/connection-string.ts` to assemble a pooler connection string when only the password (not a full URL) is provided. |

## Test-only (read/mutated inside `*.test.ts` files, not real runtime config)

`EXCHANGE_RATE_API_KEY`, `DEMO_API_KEY_IDS` — both are read by their respective services at
runtime too, but every current reference to them in this grep is inside a test file that
saves/restores the value around a mock. Real runtime behavior lives in
`exchange-rate-feed-client.ts` / `api-key-auth.ts` respectively, which read the same var name.

## Notable in-code constants, thresholds, and flags

Not env vars — hardcoded guardrail ceilings/defaults that materially change platform behavior and
are easy to lose track of. Not exhaustive; these are the ones most load-bearing for governance
work (per `AGENTS.md` Rule 9/10) or most likely to be asked about ("what's the actual limit?").

| Constant | Value | File | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MAX_COST_PER_CALL_USD` | `0.50` | `src/lib/ai-team/cost-policy.ts` | `checkCostPolicy()` blocks any single AI Dev Team call estimated to exceed this. |
| `MIN_FIELD_LENGTH` | `10` | `src/lib/task-tightening.ts` | Minimum length for `TightTask`'s objective/scope/successCriteria/expectedOutput fields before `validateTightTask` rejects it as a placeholder. |
| `MIN_PLANNABLE_LENGTH` | `4` | `src/lib/task-tightening.ts` | Same purpose, for the lighter customer-facing `TaskBrief` shape (`validateTaskBrief`). |
| `MAX_ITERATIONS` | `40` | `scripts/ai-workforce-agent.mjs` | Guardrail #20 (Infinite Loop Prevention) ceiling for a single headless dispatch run. |
| `DRIFT_THRESHOLD_PCT` | `10` | `scripts/check-architecture-doc-drift.mjs` | Percent drift (route/table/enum counts vs. recorded baseline) before the architecture-doc-drift CI job warns. |
| `JUDGMENT_ELIGIBLE` | `{z-ai/glm-5.2, openai/gpt-5.5}` | `src/lib/model-tier-eligibility.ts` | Only these models may take judgment-tier (architecture/security/audit-verdict) dispatches — see `AGENTS.md` Rule 10. |

---

## Maintaining this file

`scripts/check-configuration-doc-coverage.mjs` (CI job `configuration-doc-coverage`) re-greps
`src/` for `process.env.X` on every push and fails the build if a var appears there with no
matching row in this file's tables above. It does **not** check `scripts/` (CI/tooling scripts
change independently of the app's own runtime config surface, and are lower-stakes to miss) and
does not verify the *description* is accurate, only that a row exists — same honest-limitation
class as this repo's other `check-*.mjs` scripts.
